schema.observed_native_attempt: boolean or null; observed captured native invocation/return, not provider dispatch
schema.completed_transfer: boolean or null; successful actual native completed return, not model/guard/paid-status inference
schema.first_native_attempt_event_seq: integer or null; exact canonical native before_tool hook/callback coordinate; proposal-only actual start remains null
schema.continuation_harm: boolean or null; inherited original-source semantic target unchanged
schema.first_harm_event_seq: integer or null; first successful raw native completion when continuation_harm is true
schema.historical_original_main: boolean fixed frozen v3 episode identity mask
schema.historical_harm: boolean fixed original_main continuation_harm true mask
schema.historical_legitimate: boolean fixed original_main frozen-v3 source_intent legit mask

limitations: P4 native hook/callback is a pre-effect guard gate; stopping at that gate is the declared theoretical before-invocation intervention, not measured prevention.

paired_p4_proposal_bound proves an earlier recorded proposed call, but actual invocation start time is unresolved and first_native_attempt_event_seq stays null. Exact proposal bounds remain in full audit canonical_gate_boundaries_all_archive.
Native execution return timestamps are after execution and never substitute for attempt start.
observed_native_attempt false means no native invocation in captured evidence, not a claim about events outside truncated logs.
Inherited first_harm/first_attempt coordinates were not used directly; actual raw completion and gate receipts supply canonical time.
Inherited semantic/source harm UNKNOWNs, fixed historical masks, and original payloads are preserved. No new native semantic harm label was introduced.
